Item 2.    Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
The following discussion should be read in conjunction with the condensed consolidated financial statements. This section is part of the Form 10-Q, and Part I, Item 1A of the 2025 Form 10-K under the heading “Risk Factors” describes other factors.
Quarterly Highlights
Total net sales increased 8% or $7.0 billion during the third quarter of 2026 compared to the same quarter in 2025, driven by higher net sales of iPhone and Services.
The Company announced a new $110 billion share repurchase program during the third quarter.
Gross Margin
Products gross margin percentage decreased to 35.1% due to tariff costs of about $1.1 billion, partially offset by cost savings.
The Company expects tariff costs of about $1.5 billion in the fourth quarter of 2026.
Item 3.    Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk
There have been no material changes to the Company’s market risk during the first nine months of 2026.
Item 4.    Controls and Procedures
Based on an evaluation under the supervision of management, disclosure controls and procedures were effective.
PART II — OTHER INFORMATION
Item 1.    Legal Proceedings
Epic Games: the Company is appealing the contempt order of the District Court.
Item 1A.    Risk Factors
The Company’s business can be affected by a number of factors. The following updates the risk factors in the 2025 Form 10-K.
New tariffs announced in April 2026 on imports from China and India could materially increase the Company’s costs.
Item 2.    Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities and Use of Proceeds
